name: Expenzey Scout
author: expenzey

sections.description:
Expenzey Scout embeds a Vue admin app inside WordPress that connects your WooCommerce store to Expenzey cloud analytics and AI features.

Consent required

Store data is not synced until a site administrator accepts the in-plugin data processing disclosure during connection.

External services

This plugin connects to third-party services. Store analytics and AI features require administrator consent during onboarding. Optional Pro licensing uses Freemius only when you open pricing or activate a license.

Expenzey (hosted API)

  • Service URL: https://lrzsfushlzsmkasfxybl.supabase.co/functions/v1
  • What it is used for: Store registration, WooCommerce sync, analytics APIs, weekly reports, opportunities, usage quotas, AI chat proxy, installation revoke
  • What data is sent: Site URL, installation ID, store currency, order metrics with hashed customer identifiers, product catalog fields, truncated review text, AI chat messages, plugin integrity metadata, auth tokens
  • When data is sent: After you accept the in-plugin data processing disclosure and connect; then on scheduled sync (every 6 hours), weekly reports, and when you use dashboard, reports, opportunities, or chat features
  • Terms of service: https://expenzey.com/scout-terms-of-service/
  • Privacy policy: https://expenzey.com/scout-privacy-policy/

Google Gemini

  • What it is used for: AI-generated weekly report narratives and Store Analyst chat replies (invoked server-side by the Expenzey API; not called directly from the plugin)
  • What data is sent: Aggregated store metrics and chat prompts derived from your store data; not raw customer email addresses
  • When data is sent: After consent, when generating reports or sending chat messages
  • Terms of service: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Freemius

  • What it is used for: Optional Pro license activation, in-dashboard pricing display, and checkout
  • What data is sent: Plugin ID, plugin version, site URL, license/checkout context; payment details are entered on Freemius checkout pages
  • When data is sent: When you open Pro pricing, activate a license, or complete checkout — not required for free-tier store analytics
  • Terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Development Source Code

The frontend source code and build tooling used to generate the distributed assets are available at:
https://github.com/Abhishek325/expenzey-scout-fe

This repository contains the Vue source code, components, stores, build configuration and package dependencies used to generate the production assets included in this plugin.
sections.faq:
Does store data leave my site?

Yes, after you accept the data processing disclosure.

Can I use the plugin without connecting?

No. Expenzey Scout requires you to connect your WooCommerce store and accept the data processing disclosure before features are available.

What happens when I disconnect or uninstall?

Disconnecting suspends the remote installation and stops sync. Uninstalling removes local plugin tables, options, and chat history.

If you enable Delete cloud data on uninstall in Settings, uninstall will also request deletion of synced store data from Expenzey servers (this action cannot be undone).
